Juniper Trail Retail net sales fell 30%, from $10,000 to $7,000, for the complete comparable UTC weeks Sep 28–Oct 5 and Oct 5–12, 2026. This exceeds the agreed 10% decline threshold, so the policy-triggered recipient is the Business owner (commerce lead). [company_mcp|resource-949a4c0c44fb188d1658]

Useful breakdown: web net sales moved $7,000 to $4,000 (−$3,000); shop stayed at $3,000. These are accounting contributions to the total change, not causes. [company_mcp|resource-949a4c0c44fb188d1658]

The comparison reports complete coverage and comparable populations. It is an aggregate accounting comparison, with no estimate of statistical uncertainty; the underlying driver is not established. Returns metadata says refunds are already included in the Commerce rows, so they should not be deducted again. [company_mcp|resource-949a4c0c0c44fb188d1658] [company_mcp|resource-00dc1bfdfad5f5f05554]

Next step: commerce lead to review the web decline and investigate operational drivers. This run is delivery-disabled; no message was sent.

Juniper Trail Retail: Net sales declined 30% ($10,000 to $7,000) between complete, comparable UTC weeks 2026-09-28–2026-10-05 and 2026-10-05–2026-10-12, exceeding the agreed ≥10% decline trigger. Web fell $3,000 ($7,000 to $4,000; −42.9%); shop was unchanged at $3,000. This metric is completed-order revenue less refunds posted in the same week, excluding tax and shipping; source rows reconcile to web $8,000−$1,000 to $6,500−$2,500 and shop $4,000−$1,000 in both weeks (Commerce weekly: company_mcp|resource-949a4c0c44fb188d1658). Returns operations confirms posting week alignment and that refunds are already included; it is corroboration, not a second ledger (company_mcp|resource-00dc1bfdfad5f5f05554). No causal explanation is established. Proposed policy route: commerce/business owner team-f88d053536cba66bc88e. Data operations team-b5fcff88e8691a8a9289 is the routine report audience; no data gap indicated. Next step: commerce lead review the web decline and investigate operational context.
